stories.title: France’s 10-year bond yield heads for biggest quarterly surge since 1987

en.title: France's 10-year bond yield heads for biggest quarterly surge since 1987
en.summary: French bond yields have risen sharply in September, marking the largest quarterly increase since 1987, driven by investor concerns about inflation and rising energy costs. The government's planned €340 billion in bond issuance for next year may further strain its fiscal position.

stories.title: US SEC proposes wider retail investor access to private assets amid risk concerns

en.title: US SEC proposes wider retail investor access to private assets amid risk concerns
en.summary: The SEC has proposed rules to expand retail investor access to private assets by broadening the definition of accredited investors. Critics warn the changes could expose ordinary investors to significant risks and costs while allowing closed-end funds greater flexibility in share redemptions and classes.
